head_commit.message:
Integer factoring: keep Lean's default autoImplicit=true, as their build does

Their lakefile.toml sets no Lean options, so their 146 sources elaborate with Lean's
default autoImplicit=true (v4.35.0 src/Lean/Elab/AutoBound.lean). Our generated
lakefile set false, which could fail the build of any auto-bound implicit. Lead,
2026-10-30: add the option before the push. Profile field auto_implicit (boolean,
default false) selects the value; only the integer-factoring profile sets it. It
changes only how the sources and the frozen challenge elaborate; Comparator still
compares the elaborated statement. Tests: 195 pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
Integer factoring 1/2: closed upstream rerun profile for 1337isnot1337's claimed proof (Lean v4.33.1)

Lead decision 2026-10-30, option A. The trusted challenge is Rudich and Rousseau's Challenge.lean
(c91cc3f4, blob 6d9bf51d) byte for byte, plus one appended theorem:
IntegerFactoring.HalfAppendix.sqrtLogLog_factoring : Factoring.SqrtLogLogConjecture, that is time
C * 2^(C*n/(sqrt(log2 n)+1)), score 1/2. It has the name of the claimed proof, so their commit
e91442d3 is checked as it is; no repackaging is needed. A test pins the prefix to the frozen file.

The proof's import closure (574 modules, read statically) comes from four pinned sources: their
formal-appendix (91 roots, solution module HalfTheorem) and formal (HalfPad, HalfPrefix) at
e91442d3, Rudich c91cc3f4 (Challenge, FactoringAux), and anthropics/formal-math 16a5ce41 (six
eth/proof folders). Lean v4.33.1 with profiles/anthropic-lake-manifest.json (same package revisions
as eth's manifest, Mathlib 0df444a) and anthropic-tools.json. auto_implicit true, as their builds.

Verifier change: a solution dependency may give lean_options. The generated lakefile writes them as
[lean_lib.leanOptions] on that dependency's roots (Lake applies a library's options after the
package's). The eth folders get their lakefile's options (autoImplicit false, relaxedAutoImplicit
false, exponentiation.threshold 2048, pp.unicode.fun true). Only booleans and non-negative integers
are accepted. Every existing profile gets a byte-identical lakefile (checked against the old function
for all 10, and by a test).

An offline run of prepare() on the real downloaded trees (nothing built) staged 654 files and
planned the 574 modules with no collision. Closed: no direct.json entry; only a maintainer dispatch
of verify.yml runs it. No Lean ran on any of our machines. Tests: tests/test_integer_factoring_sqrtlog.py;
207 pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
